lore_facts: There are 'technodestroyers' significant enough to attract multiple major military forces.
The Empire fields immense warships and uses escorts called the Purple Endoguard.
The Magnate is associated with rich planetary systems capable of forming a union of armed forces.
Pirate fleets operate as opportunistic raiders, waiting to prey on weakened survivors after large battles.
The setting contains many distinct military and quasi-military factions coexisting in the same theater.
plot_events: News of a situation or prize has drawn multiple factions into the same area of space.
Technodestroyers that were already under siege become surrounded by massive imperial warships.
Those imperial ships are themselves encircled by a broader union of armed forces from wealthy planetary systems tied to the Magnate.
Pirate ships gather at the edge of the looming confrontation, waiting to exploit the aftermath rather than engage first.
